BETA Close X CRH plc announced on March 30, 2026, that it acquired 129,088 of its ordinary shares on March 27, 2026, through its broker Wells Fargo Securities, LLC, as part of its share buyback program. The total value of these repurchased shares was approximately $13.1 million, with an average price of $101.6346 per share. These repurchased shares will be cancelled, and following these transactions, CRH plc will have 668,462,772 ordinary shares in issue, excluding treasury shares, and will hold 35,643,874 ordinary shares in treasury. Disclaimer* 30 th March 2026 CRH plc Transaction in Own Shares CRH plc (“ CRH ”) announces that on 27 th March 2026 it acquired the following number of its ordinary shares (the “ ordinary shares ”) in the United States through CRH’s broker Wells Fargo Securities, LLC. The ordinary shares acquired (by way of redemption) will be cancelled. Following settlement of the above transactions and subsequent share cancellation CRH will have 668,462,772 ordinary shares in issue (excluding treasury shares). CRH will also hold 35,643,874 of its ordinary shares in treasury, which represents 5.062% of the issued ordinary share capital of CRH. Ordinary shares held in treasury do not have any voting rights.
